```{r IF_ARMC5}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

ARMC5_HEK <- read_csv("../data/Cacioppo_HEK_ARMC5_Baseline_IF_overall_summaries.csv")
ARMC5_HEK_DRUG <- read_csv("../data/Cacioppo_HEK_ARMC5_drug_IF_overall_summaries.csv")

normalisers_drug <- ARMC5_HEK_DRUG %>%
  filter(Cell=="HEK293 parental" & Drug=="Vehicle") %>%
  dplyr::select(Primary,normaliser=mean_Nuclei_intensity_mean_488_plate_normalised)

IF_bar_plot_drug <- ARMC5_HEK_DRUG %>%
      filter(Drug %in% c("Vehicle","Triptolide 300 nM")) %>%
      filter(Cell!="HEK293 ARMC5 KO 2B6") %>%
      filter(Primary=="pSer5 Pol II 3E8") %>%
      left_join(normalisers_drug,by = join_by(Primary)) %>%
  mutate(cell_labels = case_when(Cell=="HEK293 parental" ~ "Parental", Cell=="HEK293 ARMC5 KO 1A3" ~ "ARMC5 K.O."),
         cell_labels = factor(cell_labels,levels = c("Parental","ARMC5 K.O.")),
         normalised_intensity = mean_Nuclei_intensity_mean_488_plate_normalised/normaliser,
         normalised_intensity_min = (mean_Nuclei_intensity_mean_488_plate_normalised - sd_Nuclei_intensity_mean_488_plate_normalised)/normaliser,
         normalised_intensity_max = (mean_Nuclei_intensity_mean_488_plate_normalised + sd_Nuclei_intensity_mean_488_plate_normalised)/normaliser,
         ) %>%
  filter(!(cell_labels=="ARMC5 K.O." & Drug=="Triptolide 300 nM")) %>%
  mutate(cell_labels = if_else(Drug=="Triptolide 300 nM","Triptolide",cell_labels)) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_labels,normalised_intensity,normalised_intensity_min,normalised_intensity_max) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=cell_labels,y=normalised_intensity,fill=cell_labels)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin=normalised_intensity_min,
      ymax=normalised_intensity_max),
    width=0.2,
    position = position_dodge()) +
  ylab("Mean nuclear intensity\nPOLR2A pSer5 IF (3E8)") +
  ylim(c(0,1.65)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#7c2c91","#939591","red"))

IF_bar_plot_drug
```



```{r genomics_ARMC5}

ARMC5_ChIP <- read_tsv("../../ChIPseq/data/ARMC5_S5_Total_dxChIPseq_data_for_boxplots_TPL.csv")

ARMC5_ChIP_summary <- ARMC5_ChIP %>% 
  group_by(condition,dataset,target,treatment) %>% 
  summarise(sum_coverage = sum(coverage),
            n_targets = n(),
            .groups = 'drop') %>%
  filter(target=="Total Pol II")

genomics_bar_plot_drug <- ARMC5_ChIP_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(condition,treatment),values_from = sum_coverage) %>%
  mutate(`ARMC5 K.O.` = `ARMC5.KO_UNT`/WT_UNT,
         Triptolide = WT_TPL / WT_UNT,
         Parental = WT_UNT / WT_UNT) %>%
  dplyr::select(Region=dataset,Parental,`ARMC5 K.O.`, Triptolide) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Parental,`ARMC5 K.O.`,Triptolide)) %>%
  filter(Region=="TSS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=name,y=value,fill=name)) +
  geom_col() +
  ylim(c(0,1.65)) +
  ylab("dxChIP-seq coverage (TSS)\nTotal POLR2A (D8L4Y)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#7c2c91","#939591","red"))
  
genomics_bar_plot_drug + 
  IF_bar_plot_drug + 
  plot_layout(guides ="collect") & 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(1,"mm"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,hjust=1,vjust=0.5),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

ggsave("TSS_vs_Ser5p_ARMC5_triptolide.pdf",width=8,height=5,units="cm")



```


```{r}
degron_ChIP <- read_csv("../../ChIPseq/data/Degron_PolII_merged_cov_boxplot.csv")


degron_ChIP %>%
  group_by(condition,dataset,target) %>% 
  summarise(sum_coverage = sum(coverage),
            n_targets = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = sum_coverage) %>%
  mutate(fold_change=D8L4Y_90min/D8L4Y_0h)

degron_ChIP_TSS_FC <- degron_ChIP %>%
  filter(dataset=="TSS") %>%
  select(gene_id,coverage,condition) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition,values_from = coverage) %>%
  filter(D8L4Y_90min > 0 & D8L4Y_0h > 0) %>%
  mutate(fold_change = D8L4Y_90min / D8L4Y_0h)

degron_ChIP_GB_FC <- degron_ChIP %>%
  filter(dataset=="Gene Body") %>%
  select(gene_id,coverage,condition) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition,values_from = coverage) %>%
  filter(D8L4Y_90min > 0 & D8L4Y_0h > 0) %>%
  mutate(fold_change = D8L4Y_90min / D8L4Y_0h)

degron_ChIP_TSS_FC %>%
  mutate(log2_fold_change = log2(fold_change)) %>%
  summarise(median_log2_fold_change = median(log2_fold_change))

degron_ChIP_GB_FC %>%
  mutate(log2_fold_change = log2(fold_change)) %>%
  summarise(median_log2_fold_change = median(log2_fold_change))
```
